title: Weinstein attends Ed Witten's first string theory lecture

tellings.quote: I happened by complete accident to be at the first lecture of Ed Whitten on string theory at the University of Pennsylvania in 1983

plain: In 1983 the physicist Ed Witten gave his first lecture on string theory, an idea in physics that the smallest pieces of matter are tiny vibrating strings, at the University of Pennsylvania. The researcher Eric Weinstein says he was in the room, and that he got there by complete accident. He tells it as a first-hand memory of the moment a big idea in physics was starting out.
